title: Radio Sutatenza: un modelo colombiano de industria cultural y educativa
version: Boletín Cultural y Bibliográfico 46 (82), 2012, pp. 4–41. Biblioteca Luis Ángel Arango digitization.
lineage: Institutional retrospective based in part on Lázaro Jiménez’s ACPO chronology and corrections by former directors named in note 8. Independent publication from the 2020 archive bulletin with possible overlap in institutional evidence.

passages.quote: El 28 de septiembre de 1947 se realiza la primera transmisión cultural
passages.note: Gives a different first cultural broadcast day from the 2020 library bulletin. It reports early radio-school experiments in both Sutatenza and Tibirita and identifies Sutatenza’s parish priest José Ramón Sabogal as a supporter.
